RootVault

solo / duo

Vertical coco-perlite columns create a dry-top/moist-base gradient so tap-roots bulk fast and straight. A side-eject drawer slides out horizontally for dirt-free pulls.

Crop Categories & Cultivars

Roots & stems – Finger Carrot, Baby Beet, Radish, Mini Daikon, Tokyo Turnip, Baby Kohlrabi, Compact Celery
